response.original_title: Herbert Von Karajan: Dvorak - Symphonies Nos. 8 & 9
response.overview: Herbert von Karajan conducts the Vienna Philharmonic Orchestra in two masterpieces of the Romantic symphonic repertoire by Antonín Dvořák. Filmed in 1985 at the prestigious Musikverein in Vienna, these performances showcase Karajan's distinctive musical interpretation and the orchestra's exceptional artistry.  The program features Dvořák's Symphony No. 8 in G major, Op. 88, celebrated for its lyrical beauty, vibrant orchestration and Bohemian-inspired melodies, followed by Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, "From the New World", one of the composer's most celebrated works, renowned for its powerful themes, expressive Largo and triumphant finale.  Originally recorded in January and February 1985, these performances were subsequently released on DVD by Sony Classical, offering a remarkable audiovisual document of Herbert von Karajan's enduring musical legacy.
response.title: Herbert Von Karajan: Dvorak - Symphonies Nos. 8 & 9
